title: Erf - good
html:
Graph connections

Root

  • Erf - fair manner

Meaning

good · Lemma عُرْف

Surahs (2)

  • 007 Al-Araf
  • 077 Al-Mursalat

Verses (full text)

Arabic + English (Sahih International) + English (Yusuf Ali) + Urdu. Showing up to 10 verses in (web app shows all).

7:199 · 007 Al-Araf

خُذِ ٱلْعَفْوَ وَأْمُرْ بِٱلْعُرْفِ وَأَعْرِضْ عَنِ ٱلْجَـٰهِلِينَ

Word in this verse: بِٱلْعُرْفِ — the good

English (Sahih International): Take what is given freely, enjoin what is good, and turn away from the ignorant.

English (Yusuf Ali): Hold to forgiveness; command what is right; But turn away from the ignorant.

Urdu (Fatah Muhammad Jalandhari): (اے محمدﷺ) عفو اختیار کرو اور نیک کام کرنے کا حکم دو اور جاہلوں سے کنارہ کرلو

77:1 · 077 Al-Mursalat

وَٱلْمُرْسَلَـٰتِ عُرْفًا

Word in this verse: عُرْفًۭا — one after another

English (Sahih International): By those [winds] sent forth in gusts

English (Yusuf Ali): By the (Winds) sent forth one after another (to man's profit);

Urdu (Fatah Muhammad Jalandhari): ہواؤں کی قسم جو نرم نرم چلتی ہیں
